name: supabase-mcp-guard
description: A local policy wrapper for Supabase MCP that secures access tokens and enforces strict execution models, including project allowlists and write-access restrictions. It provides a safety layer to prevent AI agents from accidentally executing migrations or writing SQL against production environments.
